text:
maria: Hey team — quick async scrub for Project Tango RCA items. I sketched owners/due dates in the doc: https://redwood.in/notes/tango-rca. Can folks confirm or reassign?

ben: Looking. I can own the DB migration follow-up (item 2). Targeting 2026-04-02.

suresh: I'll take the canary rollback checklist (item 4). Will add a short runbook snippet.

dalia: I can own the telemetry gaps (item 1) but need help from infra on log retention config.

maria: thanks — tagging infra: @ashley can you confirm log-retention ETA? We need a PR and deploy plan.

ashley: I can do the retention PR. ETA 2026-03-30 for PR + 2026-04-01 deploy to staging.

ben: PR is small, will review quickly. ping me when it's up.

oncall-bot: Reminder — incident action items older than 7 days need an explicit owner + status update. (auto)

maria: also linking the failing query sample: ```SELECT user_id, count(*) FROM sessions WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY user_id;``` this is the slow one that amplifies during high fanout.

suresh: noted. For canary rollback steps I'm adding this command to the runbook: ``kubectl rollout undo deploy/tango-api --namespace=tango --to-revision=3`` — will validate in staging.

dalia: I'll add the telemetry acceptance criteria and the small eval script. Want to pair with infra on the retention change before prod.

ashley: pairing ok. when do you want to sync? I have a 30m slot tomorrow 10:30 PT.

maria: 10:30 PT works for me. If anyone can't make it, drop async notes here.

ben: FYI I created PR #567 with the index suggestion for the sessions query. Linking: https://git.redwood/PRs/567

suresh: great — I'll include the rollback validation in the canary test harness and add a test flag: `--simulate-high-fanout`.

maria: final ask — please add a single-line status in the doc under your item: owner, next-step, due-date. I'll cut the RCA brief for execs after those land.

ashley: done (owner: ashley, next-step: PR open, due: 2026-03-30).

ben: done (owner: ben, next-step: review PR #567, due: 2026-03-29).

_suresh: updating now (owner: suresh, next-step: add rollback validation, due: 2026-03-31)._

dalia: updated (owner: dalia, next-step: pair w/ infra + add eval, due: 2026-04-02).

maria: perfect — thanks all. I'll mark the RCA doc ready for execs tomorrow once the PR statuses are green. :thumbsup:

ben: quick FYI — if PR review blocks, @maria feel free to reassign to me to merge in emergency window.

maria: will do. Closing loop here unless new blockers show up.
